stem: Based on the section titled “A Source of Inspiration,” what is the most likely way that children in Garissa will read Muchilwa’s story about Gellow when it is published?

options.label: A
options.text: The children will find copies of it in the Camel Mobile Library.

options.label: B
options.text: Muchilwa will carry it for the children while he travels.

options.label: C
options.text: The government will bring the children to Nairobi to read it.

options.label: D
options.text: The schools in Garissa will give the children their own copies.
